distribution.narrative: Yan et al. (2010) explicitly list Coccotrypes dactyliperda among stored-grain insects in China, providing country-level evidence for Mainland China occurrence. Spennemann (2018) subsequently treats China as naturalised, citing Yan et al. (2010), supporting established/naturalised status. 黄昱舒等 (2026) reports Yunnan and presents the record as the first discovery in China; that priority claim is retained at source level only because earlier mainland China evidence already exists. Lau (2025) supports Hong Kong. 殷蕙芬等 (1984) records Tianjin and Qinhuangdao as input ports; those records are retained as pathway/interception evidence rather than current locality records. A previously attributed Hebei record is under re-review and is not included in the current reviewed distribution.
